events.title: Nemorsys: Next Fest Is Open
events.summary: Light exposes you. Shadow arms you. Steam Next Fest is open, October 19 to 26, and the Nemorsys demo is in it. Nemorsys is a punishing stealth-action RPG where ambient light drives all of it: your abilities, what every enemy can see and every route through a room. Charge in and you die. Snuff the lights, work the dark, and that same room becomes yours. If you tried the demo earlier this year, this is not the demo you played.
